verdict.rationale: Ironclad documents a controlled contract workflow. It has a no-code builder for creating contracts and a Workflow Designer for publishing and launching workflows. The platform also handles contract language updates, document versioning, and approval and signature policies, which supports drafting and governed routing in place of email attachments. Negotiation and redlining are only implied by 'updating new versions of the document' and are never explicitly documented. Missing for 10: explicit redlining/tracked-changes and counterparty negotiation features, and independent hands-on corroboration of the review workflow.
